title: MultiHuman-Testbench: Benchmarking Image Generation for Multiple Humans

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring deviations in the single-person ID-Similarity metric across different ethnic and racial groups (White, Black, South-Asian, East-Asian, Hispanic, Middle-East) compared to the model's average score.
Measuring deviations in the single-person ID-Similarity metric across different age brackets (Young Adult, Middle Aged, Aged) compared to the model's average score.
Measuring deviations in the single-person ID-Similarity metric across gender splits (Male, Female) compared to the model's average score.
Measuring deviations in the single-person ID-Similarity metric between anonymous individuals and celebrities to see if well-known faces are generated with higher identity fidelity.
